description: Record that the user has finished telling you about the estate's assets. Call this the moment they say there is nothing else — "that's everything", "that's the only asset", "nothing else to add". This is what turns "Has real property" and the estate size in your Estate Context from "Not yet provided" into a definite answer; until you call it those facts stay unknown and you will keep having to ask about them. BEFORE calling: make sure every asset they have named is already saved with create_asset — this tool records that the LIST is finished, it does not save assets. Call it on the SAME turn the user tells you the list is complete; do NOT ask them to confirm a second time first. For a paid estate this also starts building their asset-by-asset plan, so only call it once the list really is final. Changes the asset-collection flag and derived estate facts. For eligible paid estates, this may start public-source research, add checklist tasks, and send a completion email.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.
